flows.title: Edison Township Residential Construction & Zoning Permit Workflow
flows.description: Official step-by-step decision tree for residential construction, additions, decks, pools, sheds, and fences based on the Edison Township Zoning Permit Requirement Sheet and Ordinance O.2158.

step_scope_selection.title: Step 1 of 3: Scope of Proposed Residential Construction
step_scope_selection.message: Welcome to the Edison Township Zoning & Engineering procedural guide. Under Township Code Chapter 39, what is the primary scope of your proposed construction or property improvement?
step_scope_selection.help_text: Every exterior structural change, addition, accessory building, or ground disturbance requires verified zoning compliance before building permits can be issued.

options.label: New Single-Family Dwelling Construction
options.description: Ground-up new home construction ($200.00 review fee)

options.label: Residential Addition / Structural Alteration
options.description: Expanding dwelling footprint, second story, or structural extension ($100.00 fee)

options.label: Unenclosed Deck, Porch, or Patio
options.description: Attached or detached residential deck construction ($75.00 fee)

options.label: Swimming Pool (In-Ground or Above-Ground)
options.description: Above-ground pool ($75.00) or In-ground pool ($150.00) including barrier enclosure

options.label: Storage Shed, Detached Garage, or Fence (> 6 ft)
options.description: Accessory shed ($50-$100) or residential fence ($50.00)

step_survey_verification.title: Step 2 of 3: Property Survey Requirement Check
step_survey_verification.message: Under official Edison Zoning Permit Application Requirements (Item B), you must submit three (3) copies of a current property survey prepared by a NJ licensed land surveyor (drawn to scale: 1" = 20' or 1" = 30') showing exact property lines and the proposed structure footprint. Do you possess this survey?
step_survey_verification.help_text: Mortgage surveys or hand-drawn sketches not drawn to scale are rejected at intake per Township protocol.

options.label: Yes, I have 3 copies of a signed & sealed survey to scale
options.description: Prepared by a NJ licensed land surveyor (1"=20' or 1"=30')

options.label: No / Survey needs to be ordered or located
options.description: Need assistance understanding survey requirements

explain_survey_protocol.title: Property Survey Requirement Guidance
explain_survey_protocol.message: Edison Township strictly requires a certified survey before any zoning permit can be processed. You can check if a prior sealed survey is on file with the Division of Zoning at (732) 248-7230, or commission an updated survey from a licensed New Jersey Land Surveyor. Once ready, confirm below.

options.label: I have located / arranged the certified survey
options.description: Proceed to setback and lot coverage verification

options.label: Save requirements and return later
options.description: Download requirement sheet first

step_setback_compliance.title: Step 3 of 3: Setback & Lot Coverage Compliance
step_setback_compliance.message: Does your proposed structure maintain the required yard buffers under Edison Township Zoning Code? For decks: minimum 15-foot rear yard setback required. For pools: minimum rear/side setbacks and 4-foot self-closing barrier fence required. Total lot impervious coverage must not exceed zoning limits.
step_setback_compliance.help_text: Structures encroaching into setback buffers require a formal Land Use Variance from the Zoning Board of Adjustment before a permit can be issued.

options.label: Yes, Proposed construction conforms to all setback buffers
options.description: All dimensions fit within the legal building envelope

options.label: No / Encroaches into setback buffer (Variance Needed)
options.description: Will require a Land Use Variance from Zoning Board of Adjustment

route_to_land_use_variance.title: Zoning Board of Adjustment Variance Required
route_to_land_use_variance.message: Because the proposed improvement encroaches into municipal setback buffers or exceeds maximum lot coverage, the Division of Zoning cannot issue a standard administrative permit. You must file a formal Land Use Variance Application with the Zoning Board of Adjustment.
route_to_land_use_variance.alternative_action: Download the official Land Use Variance Application from the Document Center and contact the Zoning Board Secretary at (732) 248-7230 to schedule a hearing on the 2nd or 4th Tuesday of the month.

options.label: Adjust plans to conform to setback buffers
options.description: Modify dimensions to stay within legal setbacks

issue_edison_zoning_packet.title: Official Edison Township Zoning Permit Application Issued
issue_edison_zoning_packet.message: Zoning prerequisites verified. Download the official, authentic Edison Township Zoning Permit Application packet below. Please review the checklist of attachments and follow the municipal intake submission instructions.
issue_edison_zoning_packet.form_title: Official Edison Township Zoning Permit Application Form
issue_edison_zoning_packet.fill_in_instructions:
1. Complete all applicant, owner, and work site details (Block, Lot, Street Address).
2. Application MUST be signed by BOTH the applicant and the deed property owner.
3. Briefly describe the work being conducted in Section #5.
4. Attach three (3) copies of your property survey with proposed improvements drawn to scale.

Dimensioned architectural or construction sketches indicating proposed height and setbacks

step_traffic_impact_check.title: Step 2 of 3: Roadway Traffic Obstruction Review
step_traffic_impact_check.message: Will your excavation, trenching, or construction equipment obstruct or close any travel lane, bicycle path, or pedestrian sidewalk in Edison Township?

step_restoration_bond_check.title: Step 3 of 3: Pavement Restoration Bond Agreement
step_restoration_bond_check.message: Township regulations require a refundable $5,000.00 pavement restoration guarantee bond (or certified check) to guarantee road surface repaving and 12-month asphalt settlement stability. Are you prepared to post this bond?

issue_road_opening_packet.title: Official Edison Street Opening Application Form Issued
issue_road_opening_packet.message: Excavation prerequisites verified. Download the official, authentic Edison Township Street Opening Application below and review the submission instructions.

step_emergency_protocol_result.title: Emergency Tree Removal Protocol
step_emergency_protocol_result.message:
### Emergency Tree Removal Procedure
Because this involves an emergency situation (a dead, dying, or structurally hazardous tree posing an imminent danger):
1. **Immediate Removal Authorized**: You are authorized to proceed with removing the tree immediately to safeguard life and property.
2. **Document Required Proof**: Take clear colored photographs showing the dead/dying/hazardous condition OR obtain a certified letter from a licensed arborist/forester stating the tree is dead/dying and poses an imminent danger.
3. **Concurrent Permit Submission**: You must submit your official permit application concurrently with (or immediately following) the tree removal along with your proof.

### Important Requirements & Supporting Documents
- **Survey or Tax Map**: Draw property lines and mark existing trees with circles (and diameters noted); mark tree(s) to be removed with an X.
- **Proof of Hazard**: Colored photographs of the hazardous tree condition OR certified letter from licensed arborist/forester.
- **Written Reason**: Brief written statement describing the reason for removal.
- **Ribbon / Paint**: Mark the tree or stump on site with ribbon or paint for municipal inspection.
- **Filing Fee**: $25.00 for single residential lot (fee is waived for Senior Citizens age 62+ with ID).

### Next Steps
1. Safely remove the hazardous tree.
2. Download and complete the official **Township of Edison Tree Permit Application** below.
3. Submit the completed application, proof of hazard, and fee to the Division of Engineering counter (100 Municipal Blvd) or via the online Document Center.

---
### Relevant Official Documents & Forms
- **Tree Removal Permit Application** – Official Township application form (`3.23.21 tree permit application.pdf`).
step_emergency_protocol_result.form_title: Township of Edison Tree Permit Application (Removal / Replacement / Conservation)
step_emergency_protocol_result.fill_in_instructions:

2. Note Number of Trees On-Site and Number of Trees to be Removed.
3. Check appropriate fee category ($25 for single residential lot; waived for senior citizens age 62+ with ID).
4. Attach colored photos of dead/dying tree OR arborist certification, and Survey/Tax Map sketch.
5. Mark tree on site with ribbon or paint for inspection.
6. Submit concurrently with removal to the Division of Engineering.
required_attachments: Survey or Tax Map sketch showing property lines, existing trees with diameter, and removal trees marked with an X
Colored photographs of dead/dying/hazard tree condition OR certified statement from licensed arborist/forester
Written statement detailing the reason for removal (Township Ordinance 25-8.1a6)
Payment of $25 fee (check/card payable to 'Township of Edison') or Senior ID (age 62+)

fee_info.amount: $25.00 for single residential lot (Waived for Senior Citizens age 62+ with ID; $200 with Board approval / subdivision)

step_planned_permit_required_result.title: Tree Removal Permit Required
step_planned_permit_required_result.message:
### Tree Removal Procedure
Under Township of Edison Tree Protection Ordinance (Chapter 25-8), a **Tree Removal Permit is REQUIRED** before removing one or more mature trees (trunk diameter of 4 inches or greater at breast height).

### Important Requirements & Supporting Documents
- **Survey or Tax Map**: Property sketch showing house location, existing trees circled with trunk diameter, and proposed removal trees marked with an X.
- **Written Statement**: Written explanation detailing reasons for removal (Ordinance 25-8.1a6).
- **Field Marking**: Trees proposed for removal must be visibly marked on site with ribbon or paint for municipal inspection.
- **Tree Replacement Plan**: Required if removing more than 25% of the trees on the property.
- **Filing Fee**: $25.00 for single residential lots (waived for senior citizens age 62+ with ID).

### Next Steps
1. Download the official **Township of Edison Tree Permit Application** below.
2. Complete property owner details, tree counts, and attach survey sketch.
3. Submit application and fee to the Division of Engineering counter (100 Municipal Blvd) or online.
4. Await municipal inspection sign-off prior to tree removal.

---
### Relevant Official Documents & Forms
- **Tree Removal Permit Application** – Official Township application form (`3.23.21 tree permit application.pdf`).
step_planned_permit_required_result.form_title: Township of Edison Tree Permit Application (Removal / Replacement / Conservation)
step_planned_permit_required_result.fill_in_instructions:
1. Complete Property Owner data, Subject Permit Site Address, Block, and Lot.
2. Note Number of Trees On-Site and Number of Trees to be Removed.

4. Attach Survey or Tax Map sketch showing tree locations and diameters.
5. Visibly mark trees on site with ribbon or paint for municipal inspector.
6. Submit application to the Division of Engineering.

submission_routing.desk: Division of Engineering, Edison Municipal Complex

step_subdivision_permit_required_result.title: Tree Removal Permit Required (Subdivision / Demolition)
step_subdivision_permit_required_result.message:
### Tree Removal Procedure (Subdivision / Demolition)
Under Township of Edison Code (Chapter 25-8), because your project is part of a subdivision or requires a demolition permit from Code Enforcement, an official **Tree Removal Permit is REQUIRED** before tree removal or demolition can proceed.

### Important Requirements & Supporting Documents
- **Board Approval Resolution**: Copy of Planning Board or Zoning Board resolution approving subdivision/site plan development.
- **Tree Conservation Plan**: Copy of approved Tree Conservation / Replacement Plan.
- **Sealed Plot Plan**: Three (3) copies of sealed plot plan with replacement schedule in accordance with Chapter 12.16.150A.
- **Permit Fee**: $200.00 in conjunction with Board approval / subdivision; $25.00 for single lot with demolition permit.

### Next Steps
1. Download the official **Township of Edison Tree Permit Application** below.
2. Complete application with contractor details and attach board approval resolution.
3. Submit application packet to the Division of Engineering counter (100 Municipal Blvd).

---
### Relevant Official Documents & Forms
- **Tree Removal Permit Application** – Official Township application form (`3.23.21 tree permit application.pdf`).

step_subdivision_permit_required_result.fill_in_instructions:

2. Attach copy of Planning/Zoning Board Resolution and Tree Conservation/Replacement Plan.
3. Attach 3 copies of sealed plot plan with replacement schedule.
4. Submit application packet to the Division of Engineering.
required_attachments: Copy of Planning Board / Zoning Board approval resolution
Copy of Tree Conservation / Replacement Plan
Three (3) copies of sealed plot plan with replacement schedule
Permit fee ($200.00 for subdivision / site plan; $25.00 for single lot with demolition permit)

step_permit_not_required_result.title: Tree Removal Permit NOT Required
step_permit_not_required_result.message:
### Applicable Determination
Under Township of Edison regulations, because you are not removing any trees and your project is not part of a subdivision or demolition permit from Code Enforcement, **a Tree Removal Permit is NOT required**.

### Important Information
- No tree removal application filing or municipal permit fee is required for your project.
- If your project scope changes in the future to include tree removal, site disturbance, or road excavation, please check back for applicable permits.

### Next Steps
You may proceed with your planned project without a tree removal permit.

step_soil_import_permit_required_result.title: Soil Import Permit Required
step_soil_import_permit_required_result.message:
### 1. Applicable Procedure
Because you are importing 10 cubic yards or more of soil onto your property in Edison Township, a **Soil Importation Permit** is required under municipal regulations prior to bringing any fill onto the site.

### 2. Important Requirements & Supporting Documents
- **Certified Clean Fill Lab Analysis**: Chemical laboratory certification verifying clean fill from the source site.
- **Property Survey & Grading Plan**: Topographical survey showing proposed fill placement and grading contours.
- **Designated Haul Route**: Approved truck haul route through Edison Township.
- **Filing Fee & Engineering Escrow**: Municipal review fee and inspection escrow deposit.

### 3. Next Steps for Resident
1. Download and complete the official **Township of Edison Soil Importation Permit Application** below.
2. Obtain clean fill certification documentation from your supplier.
3. Prepare a grading sketch or survey showing where soil will be placed.
4. Submit the completed application and attachments to the Division of Engineering.
5. Wait for engineering review and permit issuance before transporting soil.

### Relevant Official Documents & Forms
- [Township of Edison Soil Importation Permit Application (PDF)](/api/forms/engineering/Forms_Soil_Importation_Appl.pdf)

2. Detail source of fill and attach clean fill lab certification.
3. Attach property survey showing proposed grading.
4. Submit to Division of Engineering.
required_attachments: Certified laboratory clean fill analysis
Property survey showing proposed fill placement and grading contours
Designated truck haul route plan
Soil importation review fee and engineering escrow deposit

step_soil_export_permit_required_result.title: Soil Export Permit Required
step_soil_export_permit_required_result.message:
### 1. Applicable Procedure
Because you are exporting 10 cubic yards or more of soil from your property in Edison Township, a **Soil Exportation Permit** is required under municipal regulations prior to removing soil from the site.

### 2. Important Requirements & Supporting Documents
- **Topographical Survey with Cut/Fill Calculations**: Prepared and certified by a NJ licensed professional engineer or surveyor.
- **Soil Erosion & Sediment Control Certification**: Measures to prevent runoff during excavation.
- **Designated Truck Haul Route**: Specific route through township roadways.
- **Filing Fee & Performance Guarantee**: Application fee and restoration guarantee bond.

### 3. Next Steps for Resident
1. Download and complete the official **Township of Edison Soil Exportation Permit Application** below.
2. Coordinate with your engineer/contractor to prepare the cut/fill calculations and haul route.
3. Submit the completed application and attachments to the Division of Engineering.
4. Await engineering review and permit issuance before hauling soil off-site.

### Relevant Official Documents & Forms
- [Township of Edison Soil Exportation Permit Application (PDF)](/api/forms/engineering/Forms_Soil_Exportation_App.pdf)

4. Submit to Division of Engineering.

Soil erosion and sediment control certification

step_soil_permit_not_required_result.title: Soil Permit Not Required
step_soil_permit_not_required_result.message:
### 1. Applicable Procedure
Under official Township of Edison engineering guidelines, because your project involves **less than 10 cubic yards of soil**, a municipal Soil Import / Export Permit is **NOT required**.

### 2. Important Requirements & Environmental Best Practices
- **No Permit or Fee**: No municipal soil permit application, review fee, or escrow deposit is required for quantities under 10 cubic yards.
- **Drainage Protection**: When placing soil, ensure that grading does not alter natural drainage patterns or direct stormwater runoff onto neighboring properties.
- **Ground Disturbance Check**: If your project also involves major site grading (disturbing 1,250 sq.ft. or more) or new impervious coverage (500 sq.ft. or more), an engineering Site Improvement review may be required.

### 3. Next Steps for Resident
You may proceed with your project without filing a soil permit application. If you have additional engineering or zoning questions, visit https://www.edisonnj.org/document_center/index.php.

step_site_permit_required_result.title: Site Improvement Permit Required
step_site_permit_required_result.message:
### 1. Applicable Procedure
Under official Edison Township engineering regulations, your project requires an approved **Site Improvement Permit (SIP)** with Checklist prior to commencing site work, grading, or ground disturbance.

### 2. Important Requirements & Supporting Documents
- **Site Improvement Plan**: Two (2) signed and sealed copies of engineering site plans prepared by a NJ licensed professional engineer.
- **Completed 25-Point Checklist**: Official municipal Site Improvement Checklist completed by applicant or engineer.
- **Stormwater Management Report**: Runoff calculations and drainage design.
- **Review & Inspection Escrow**: Engineering review fee and inspection escrow deposit.

### 3. Next Steps for Resident
1. Download and complete the official **Township of Edison Site Improvement Permit Application with Checklist** below.
2. Work with your licensed civil engineer to prepare sealed site improvement plans.
3. Submit the completed application, checklist, plans, and review fees to the Division of Engineering.
4. Await engineering review and permit issuance before commencing any excavation or grading.

### Relevant Official Documents & Forms
- [Township of Edison Site Improvement Permit Application with Checklist (PDF)](/api/forms/engineering/SIP_Application.pdf)

step_site_permit_not_required_result.title: Site Improvement Permit May Not Be Required
step_site_permit_not_required_result.message:
### 1. Applicable Procedure
Under official Township of Edison guidelines, a **Site Improvement Permit may not be required** for your project because your work does not exceed 500 sq.ft. of impervious coverage, does not exceed 1,250 sq.ft. of disturbance, and does not alter drainage or grading.

### 2. Important Requirements & Next Steps
- **Final Determination**: A final determination will be made when your standard Zoning Permit or Building Permit application is reviewed by the township.
- If your project scope expands to exceed coverage thresholds or includes site grading, a Site Improvement review will then be required.

### 3. Next Steps for Resident
You may proceed with submitting your standard zoning/building permit application. For municipal document references, visit https://www.edisonnj.org/document_center/index.php.
